alignments.note: Verbless clause; the dative pronoun is the predicate and carries the supplied copula under rules 53 and 63, discontinuously under rule 15. The competing reading puts 'is' on the predicate nominal 'preciousness'.

Substantival article before a participle supplies only a pronoun (rule 32); the ASV writes none here, the pronoun being already spent on 'you' for the appositional dative, so the article is unrepresented under rule 23.
The supplied relativizer is the participle's helper under rules 7 and 32.
Anarthrous dative participle; the case preposition and the supplied 'such as' frame are helpers on the participle under rules 7 and 21.
Greek anarthrous, so the supplied determiner is an ordinary helper on the noun under rule 51.
Article aligned to 'the' under rule 19; the participle is rendered by a noun, so no pronoun is in question.
Substantival demonstrative takes the whole expression headed on the demonstrative word under rules 17 and 49.
Head on the lexical verb rather than the auxiliary under rules 9 and 17.
The ASV writes 'was made the head', absorbing the preposition into the predicate, so it is realized nowhere (rule 36).
Anarthrous noun with a supplied determiner under rule 51.
Anarthrous genitive; the case preposition and supplied determiner ride with the noun under rules 21 and 51.
